mechanics.title: Synchronized Heartbeat
mechanics.spec: 60 BPM, derived client-side from Date.now() % 1000, identical phase across cities

mechanics.title: Daily Ceremony
mechanics.spec: Sixty seconds at each operational city's chosen Cor hour (typically aligned with local sunset, declared by each city when it goes Operational). The rotation activates city by city as each reaches Operational: Andorra first (around Year 5), Adelaide and Yokohama next (Years 8-9), then Valparaíso, Cape Town, and Jaipur (Years 11-13). Full six-city rotation once all are Operational. Order: Andorra, Adelaide, Yokohama, Valparaíso, Cape Town, Jaipur, then loop.

mechanics.title: Cor Residency
mechanics.spec: Each operational city hosts a city-specific number of incoming creative residents per year, sized to its actual cottage capacity. Andorra 5/yr (microstate seed), Yokohama 15/yr (international port, Yamate Heights cottage stock), Adelaide 10/yr (Bowden bluestone), Valparaíso 10/yr (Cerro Alegre/Concepción), Cape Town 10/yr (Bo-Kaap and Woodstock plus Greatmore Studios), Jaipur 10/yr (buffer-adjacent havelis). Network ramp: 5/yr from Andorra's Operational (Year 5), 20/yr as Yokohama joins, 30/yr as Adelaide joins, 60/yr at the full Network phase once all six are Operational. The 60/yr network target is preserved.

mechanics.title: Annual Cor Biennale
mechanics.spec: Rotating two-month festival of love urbanism, on a cultural calendar independent of monument completion. Rotation by round, not fixed years: Andorra, Yokohama, Valparaíso, Cape Town, Adelaide (hosting before its monument opens, as a pre-opening cultural countdown), Jaipur, then an illustrative Wave-2 transitional round, then loops.

mechanics.title: Cor Pattern Library
mechanics.spec: Open-source repo of love-urbanism patterns under CC BY-NC 4.0. Each operational city contributes at least three patterns per year. Network total ramps with city operationals: ~10 patterns by Year 3, ~40 by Year 8, ~80 by Year 11, 100 by Year 13, 200 by Year 18 (with Wave-2 contributions).

mechanics.title: Wave-2 Admission
mechanics.spec: Opens at the Network phase (around Year 15), after the wave-1 six are all operational. Candidate cities apply via four signatures (site, monument, roadmap, hosting). Illustrative target: 30+ participating cities over the network lifetime. Marrakech is named only as an illustrative Wave-2 transitional candidate associated with the Cape Town African cluster; it has not been approached and no participation is agreed.

mechanics.title: Shared Heart-Core
mechanics.spec: Every monument is the same 12-metre living heart, the shared heart-core made the whole building, differing only in its city's materials and skin: a couple stands in the identical 12-metre heart whether in Andorra or Jaipur. By night, during accepted hours, it becomes a heart of light that beats, sending out waves of light-hearts that ripple on every pulse of the shared 60 BPM heartbeat, dimmed away from homes and protected views, weightless and fully reversible. The literal expression of unity, costing little and asking nothing of any skyline.

mechanics.title: The Cor Year
mechanics.spec: A year-round calendar relay. Each city anchors one window of the year with a network-wide love-and-life theme, rooted in its own real festival, and the baton passes city to city: Valparaíso (January, Año Nuevo en el Mar), Adelaide (March, festival season), Andorra (April, Sant Jordi roses), Jaipur (August, Teej), Cape Town (September, Heritage), Yokohama (October, jazz and the harbour), then loops. This sits on top of the Daily Ceremony (a sunset relay around the globe) and the Annual Biennale (a rotating host).

stages.name: Charter
stages.definition: The Cor Charter is signed with the city government, and an international architecture competition for the monument is awarded. The site is secured.

stages.name: Break Ground
stages.definition: Construction begins on both the monument and the first Hearths-of-the-Heart housing block. The first Cor Residency cohort arrives in restored or temporary housing.

stages.name: Operational
stages.definition: The monument opens. The Daily Ceremony broadcasts begin from this city at its declared Cor hour. The first 1,000 Hearts-of-the-Heart units are delivered. The first Cor Generation residents move into the city's network units.

stages.name: Generation
stages.definition: Twenty-five years after Operational. The first Cor Generation children raised in the network reach adulthood. A second-wave expansion (community pavilion, residency wing, or Pattern-Library archive) is added to the original monument. The city graduates into network elder status, mentoring Wave-2 candidates.

phases.name: Genesis
phases.description: Andorra builds. Adelaide and Yokohama enter design. Valparaíso and Cape Town enter charter discussions.

phases.name: Activation
phases.description: Andorra opens. Adelaide and Yokohama under construction. Cor Residency begins ramping as Andorra reaches Operational.

phases.name: Spread
phases.description: Adelaide and Yokohama open. Valparaíso, Cape Town, Jaipur under construction. Cor Residency reaches 30 to 40 incoming per year network-wide.

phases.name: Network
phases.description: Valparaíso, Cape Town, Jaipur reach operational. The full wave-1 six is open. Cor Residency reaches the target of 60 per year. Wave-2 admission opens.

phases.name: Lifetime
phases.description: Wave-2 ramp. Network grows toward 30+ participating cities. The first city (Andorra) approaches its quarter-century Generation milestone around Year 30.
